title: Eagle: Ethical Dataset Given from Real Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's propensity to generate biased text using an average log-likelihood metric (Unethical Likelihood-based Score, LLS) on real-world ChatGPT-user interactions from the Eagle dataset, and comparing the results against the BBQ benchmark, which evaluates the rate of selecting anti-stereotypical over pro-stereotypical examples.

Evaluating the model's generation propensity using the Unethical Likelihood-based Score (LLS) on real-world prompts, and comparing it against the Opinion QA dataset, which measures the degree of alignment between LLM outputs and human stance distributions from public opinion surveys.
